Metadata.CommitMsg:
handoff: prepare the repo for a Codex port

Adds docs/HANDOFF.md — the orientation map for an agent picking up Drydock
cold: the four-tier thesis, which parts are the harness-agnostic brain vs the
Claude-specific wrapping, what is proven vs assumed, a reading order, and the
house rules that explain the paranoid-looking choices.

Adds docs/CODEX_PORT_PROPOSAL.md — a proposal written FOR Codex to critique,
with every guess flagged as an assumption. Codex has already reviewed it and
returned five blocking concerns (recorded for the next round): plugin hooks are
non-managed so the tier-4 claim needs restating; the conductor is not shared
core; the five hooks are unproven on Codex tool names; the reverse Claude
bridge is unauthenticated; and the execution/worktree ownership model is absent.

Also ships codex-coplan (two-brain plan negotiation, verified and archived) and
tidies repo noise for the handoff. Suite 501.
